unmodelled.text: Must live in an Anganwadi or Mini Anganwadi area of the scheduled (tribal) area
unmodelled.source_quote: residing in Anganwadi/Mini Anganwadi areas of scheduled area

ambiguous: Children qualify from 7 months; the app counts age in whole years, so babies under 7 months (age 0) are not excluded
'7 months to 6 years' is read as up to and including age 6

en.title: Bharat Ratna Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam Amrut Aahar Yojana
en.benefit: One hot meal a day for pregnant and lactating mothers, and eggs or bananas for children aged 7 months to 6 years.
en.how_to_apply: Provided through Anganwadi centres in the scheduled areas.
